summary: Senti Biosciences filed an 8-K on July 14, 2026, disclosing a merger agreement with Celadon Partners SPV 35, an affiliate of its largest stockholder Celadon Partners. Under the deal, a private affiliate will acquire substantially all of the company's business and pipeline, leaving Senti as a streamlined public company retaining its Regulator Dial platform and certain IP. Stockholders and equity/warrant holders will receive contingent value rights tied to SENTI-202 milestones. The transaction requires stockholder approval and is subject to customary closing conditions. Watch for potential regulatory scrutiny and stockholder vote outcomes, with risk-arb focusing on milestone-dependent CVR valuation.
